'''Triank''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]]'s [[Mantellian Army|army]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where a [[Separatist War|civil war]] had broken out with the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]]. Triank was posted on the outskirts of [[Fort Garnik]] on [[Avilatan]] island, where he operated a stall from which he sold medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. While at his stall Triank wore [[Color/Legends|blue]] armor and white [[Clothing/Legends|pants]]. He had fair skin, brown hair and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Triank first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]].<ref name="TOR" />
